name: Tharek Blackstone
summary: At the forge in Kharanos, Tharek Blackstone makes and repairs tools for local craftsmen. His trade keeps him busy, so he hires travelers to carry finished crates to Beldin Steelgrill at Steelgrill's Depot.

sections.title: A Busy Toolsmith in Kharanos
sections.body: Beldin's mechanostrider depot just outside town needs heavy wrenches, gears, and replacement tools. Tharek sends each crate there with a passing traveler, keeping deliveries moving while he stays at the forge. Craftsmen across Kharanos also rely on the tools he makes and repairs.

sections.title: A Community Figure
sections.body: Tharek has earned respect across Dun Morogh through his work at the anvil. He holds no military title, yet people in town turn to him for odd jobs, supply runs, and help coordinating local efforts.

faq.answer: Tharek Blackstone is a dwarven toolsmith in Kharanos, Dun Morogh. He makes and repairs heavy tools for local workers, and hires passing travelers to deliver supplies around the valley.

faq.q: What is his relationship with Beldin Steelgrill?
faq.answer: Beldin Steelgrill runs Steelgrill's Depot just east of Kharanos, where mechanostriders and siege engines are repaired. He is Tharek's main customer and orders so much ironware that Tharek often hires travelers to deliver finished shipments to the depot.

faq.q: Where can I find Tharek Blackstone?
faq.answer: Tharek Blackstone stands outside near the center of Kharanos in Dun Morogh, within easy walking distance of the local inn and forge.

faq.q: Does Tharek hold any official rank in Ironforge?
faq.answer: Tharek holds no military commission or political office. He is a busy toolsmith who hires newcomers in need of coin to carry supplies for him.

angles.text: For smiths passing through Kharanos, Tharek shows the daily work of a toolsmith, making sturdy wrenches and iron fittings for dwarven machinery.
As a dwarf, you share Dun Morogh's working spirit. Local industry depends on people who keep at the anvil.
